# World and style

## At a glance

An unnamed British city today, photographic and plain, in the wide 2.39 to 1 frame, with no music.

## Rules of the story's world

- From scene 6 the world is reversed around Iona, Jude and Eli: in scene 10, Saye and her kitchen are shown mirrored.
- Titles are always read normally.
